title: Glossary
description: A site's translation glossary (RFC-0033 §2): terms with their approved translation per locale, and terms never to translate (brand and product names). Agents translating content read it as hard constraints; the checks flag drafts that break it. One per site, snapshotted like every node.

entries.description: Unique by term (case-insensitive); order is the editor's.

term.description: The term as written in the site's default locale.

note.description: Context for translators and agents: meaning, part of speech, where it appears.

doNotTranslate.description: Keep the term as written in every locale (brand, product or proper names). Such an entry has no translations.

caseSensitive.description: Match the term only with this exact capitalisation.

translations.description: The approved translation per locale (never the default locale).
